caption: The loop divides, updates the coefficient pairs, and stops when the remainder is zero. On 252 and 105 the first pass gives q=2 and r2=42; after further passes the output is gcd=21, x=−2, y=5.

spec.title: Extended Euclidean loop
spec.aria: A vertical flowchart of the extended Euclidean algorithm starting with a=252 and b=105, dividing to get quotient 2 and remainder 42, updating coefficients, testing for zero remainder, and outputting gcd 21 with coefficients −2 and 5, with a shift step looping back.
